**Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov equations in Deligne categories**

*P. Etingof ⋆, I. Motorin*, A. Varchenko♢, and I. Zhu†*

20 pp, 18 sections.

**Abstract.** We consider the Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov equations in Deligne Categories in the context of (gl𝑚, gl𝑛) and (so𝑚, so2𝑛) dualities. We derive integral formulas for the solutions in the first case and compute monodromy in both cases.
